description: Rows "Occlusion test", "Removed-volume check" and "Position refinement" of main-text Table 2 and the trace length retained in the labels, from the label reports of the 50 images of the multi-illumination aerial set (frames: one row per image). occluded_share: occluded length / in-frame length. occluded_on_uncut_surface_share: visible length that would be classed as occluded if the occlusion test were run on the uncut rock surface, as a fraction of the visible length. shift_px_p50_p99_max: 3-D displacement of the sample points by the position refinement (median, 99th percentile, maximum over the sample points of a frame) divided by the nominal pixel size.
paper_items: main text Table 2, rows "Occlusion test", "Removed-volume check" and "Position refinement"
main text Section 4.2, first paragraph, and the unclear length per image (2.6%-15.7% of the visible length)
main text Section 5.3, second paragraph (near-nadir viewpoint 26120001_c0: visible 99.6%, visible and not unclear 84%-93%)
supplement S4: role of each step and the mask skeleton, first paragraph

units.occluded_share: occluded_px / projected_in_frame_px (sums over per_path; image pixels of trace length)
units.occluded_on_uncut_surface_share: exempt_with_occluder_length_px / visible_length_px (image pixels of trace length)

notes: The denominator of occluded_on_uncut_surface_share is the length that is visible on the cut mesh, not the in-frame length.

The percentiles of the displacement weight all sample points equally, including points outside the frame and occluded points; the displacement is a 3-D distance converted to nominal pixels, not an image displacement.

The occluded share, the removed-volume share and the displacement depend only on geometry and viewpoint: the 10 frames of a viewpoint (5 illumination conditions x 2 render seeds) have the same value. The unclear length changes with illumination and render seed.
